description: Exact arclength-to-arclength visibility law on every orthogonal six-edge L-domain, with analytic threshold and a fourth-order singularity in the square-notch family.
scientific_integrity: Proof and finite numerical diagnostics are distinguished; area-uniform Beer-index and invariant-line chord laws are credited as prior work, not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to orthogonal L polygons and perimeter-uniform independent endpoints; numerical experiments do not prove analytic statements. Historical priority is provisional; specialized unindexed boundary-visibility formulae may exist.
title: A boundary-visibility phase law for orthogonal L-polygons
